Its Install contract tells users to set their OpenRouter key in Alethe Preferences > Voice; voice commands and OpenRouter dictation use that key. The plugin keeps model-use cost history, and Alethe’s backend reads the key from its OS keychain for the OpenRouter model request. This provider-key usage is separate from optional Alethe Cloud Supporter billing.
